---
name: engineering-guard-router
description: Route independent critique of plans, architecture, code, risks, or verification evidence to the smallest review lens.
---
# Engineering Guard router

Read the original requirement and supplied evidence. Route planning readiness to `implementation-readiness`, architecture/data/API risks to `architecture-risk-review`, and code/test/security/performance evidence to `implementation-review`. Findings must be `BLOCKING`, `IMPORTANT`, or `OPTIONAL`.

Do not implement fixes or expand scope merely because a finding exists. Exit with review evidence and severity.
